items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bürgergeld award
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority (SGB X). Deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, rule applicable to letters posted since 2025): 19.11.2026 + 4 days = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule itself). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB i.V.m. § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), i.e. from 23.11.2026, and ends one month later on the same calendar date (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23.12.2026. That Wednesday is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Brandenburg, so no further shift (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). Final day the Widerspruch must reach the Jobcenter: 23.12.2026.
